subject: Web Development
title: The Browser Engine
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Browser Engine usable.

hook.text: Behind every browser is an engine that turns code into the pages you see.

buildup.text: The engine handles parsing HTML, applying CSS, and coordinating everything on screen.

discovery.text: Blink powers Chrome and Edge. WebKit powers Safari. Gecko powers Firefox.

twist.text: Most browsers now share the same engine. True diversity has shrunk dramatically.

climax.text: Engine monoculture means faster standards adoption but less resilience to bugs.

punchline.text: Three engines power almost every browser.
